summary: OpenAI announced that an internal, unreleased version of its next major model, Astra, produced novel solutions to ten longstanding open problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science, with proofs formalized in Lean and released for community review.

mechanisms.reason: The document describes an unreleased frontier model achieving first-time solutions to problems unsolved for a decade or more across multiple deep mathematical fields, a first demonstration of a new task class.
mechanisms.quote: we are sharing a selection of ten results to problems that have been open and have seen no progress on the main result for at least a decade, and in most cases much longer

practices.reason: The result signals a major reasoning capability gain in OpenAI's next model, but since the model is internal and unreleased, there is nothing yet to build on.
practices.quote: The results were achieved by an internal version of Astra, our next major model.

practices.reason: Formalizing model-generated mathematical arguments as Lean certificates is a transferable correctness-verification technique engineering teams could apply to trust model outputs on formal domains.
practices.quote: Afterward, the model formalized each argument in a Lean certificate .

notable_reason: An unreleased frontier model reportedly solving ten decades-old open problems across disparate mathematical fields is a significant, concrete capability signal ahead of the model's public release.
